patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Microsoft Project and Motion share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Microsoft Project and Motion share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Microsoft Project only if your buying job matches “Microsoft 365 project / Planner ladder for Gantt, resources and portfolios — Planner Plan ” rather than Motion's shape. Choose Motion only if your buying job matches “AI calendar + task auto-scheduling (projects, docs, meetings) — Pro AI from $19/seat/mo an” rather than Microsoft Project's shape. Workflow advantage: Microsoft Project leans resource-planning, timeline-reporting; Motion leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Microsoft Project and Motion share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Microsoft Project is Microsoft 365 project / Planner ladder for Gantt, resources and portfolios — Planner Plan 1 from ~$10/user/mo.; Motion is AI calendar + task auto-scheduling (projects, docs, meetings) — Pro AI from $19/seat/mo annual..
- Company-size focus: Microsoft Project (mid-market, enterprise) vs Motion (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Microsoft Project-leaning resource-planning, timeline-reporting vs Motion-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Microsoft Project — SKU and licensing complexity across Planner/Project plans; Motion — Premium $19+ seats vs broader Work OS floors.

Limitations — Microsoft Project: SKU and licensing complexity across Planner/Project plans; Best value assumes Microsoft 365 standardisation; Motion: Premium $19+ seats vs broader Work OS floors; AI credit caps and top-ups affect TCO.

Poor-fit cases: Microsoft Project is a poor fit when that limitation bites: SKU and licensing complexity across Planner/Project plans · Motion is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Premium $19+ seats vs broader Work OS floors · Avoid Microsoft Project if you actually need Motion's motion (AI calendar + task auto-scheduling (projects, docs, meetings) — Pro AI from $19/)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
